title: California Insurance Code Section 10127.11 (illustration notice on life policies sold to senior citizens)
updateCadence: Amended only by legislation. The section credit on the official host at the time of access read Amended by Stats. 1998, Ch. 379, Sec. 1. Effective January 1, 1999.
claims: Section 10127.11 requires every insurer and life agent offering individual life insurance policies or individual annuity contracts initially delivered or issued for delivery to senior citizens in California on and after January 1, 1995, with the use of nonpreprinted illustrations of nonguaranteed values, to disclose prominently on the illustration or an attached cover sheet the statement THIS IS AN ILLUSTRATION ONLY. AN ILLUSTRATION IS NOT INTENDED TO PREDICT ACTUAL PERFORMANCE. INTEREST RATES, DIVIDENDS, OR VALUES THAT ARE SET FORTH IN THE ILLUSTRATION ARE NOT GUARANTEED, EXCEPT FOR THOSE ITEMS CLEARLY LABELED AS GUARANTEED.

Section 10127.11 requires all preprinted policy illustrations to contain that notice in 12-point bold print, and requires all preprinted illustrations containing nonguaranteed values to show the columns of guaranteed values in bold print, with all other columns in standard print.
Section 10127.11 provides that values as used in the section includes cash value, surrender value, and death benefit.
